overview: The Medford City Council ordained a new vacant building ordinance, approved several labor-related resolutions concerning Tufts University, and voted to provide only one month of supplemental funding to the Law Department pending the receipt of specific litigation data. The Council also addressed safety at the West Medford train station following a resident's death and handled various administrative election and community preservation items.

items.title: Remembrance of John Westwater and Train Station Safety
items.summary: Approved a resolution in memory of John Westwater and called on the MBTA and Amtrak to implement safety improvements at the West Medford station to prevent future pedestrian accidents.

items.title: Approval of Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved meeting records from June and July 2026 and committee reports regarding the public tree ordinance and ICE enforcement regulations.

items.title: Update to the Noise Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a resolution to update the city's 1974 noise ordinance to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee for modernization and public input.

items.title: Election Administration and Polling Relocations
items.summary: Approved the temporary relocation of the Ward 4 Precinct 2 polling place and finalized the call and warrant for the September 1, 2026, State Primary.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings
items.summary: Referred a resolution scheduling hybrid neighborhood meetings for Wards 1, 2, and 5 back to committee for further coordination with city communications.

items.title: Support for Tufts University Workers and Students
items.summary: Approved resolutions demanding Tufts University reinstate a graduate worker facing alleged retaliation and supporting facilities workers in their contract negotiations.

items.title: Police Chief Search Funding
items.summary: Tabled a $35,000 appropriation for a police chief executive search until the State Legislature finalizes the Home Rule petition regarding the hiring process.

items.title: Board Appointments and Community Preservation Funding
items.summary: Approved various board appointments and appropriated CPA funds for a digital scoreboard at Playstead Park and restoration work at the Osgoode House.

items.title: Payment of Previous Fiscal Year Bill
items.summary: Approved a $1,500 expenditure to pay a permitting software bill from a previous fiscal year.

items.title: Law Department Supplemental Appropriation and Litigation Transparency
items.summary: Approved a reduced supplemental appropriation of $42,507.63 and passed a resolution demanding a categorized accounting of all city litigation and settlement costs since 2020.

items.title: Ordination of Vacant Building and Personnel Ordinances
items.summary: Ordained the Vacant Building Ordinance as amended following negotiations with the Chamber of Commerce, alongside updates to Health and Human Services personnel and the Commission for Persons with Disabilities.
